adaptation_measures: Avoid strenuous field operations during peak heat hours.

texts.bulletin: HIGH HEAT STRESS — Cordon: Avoid prolonged field work from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Ensure adequate hydration for farm workers. Monitor heat-sensitive crops (vegetables, high-value crops). Reschedule spraying and transplanting to early morning hours. Check livestock ventilation and water supply.

texts.bulletin: OPERATIONS ADVISORY - DEFER OPEN-AIR GRAIN DRYING - Cordon: sun-drying of palay or corn grain should be deferred. Basis: high humidity slows drying and increases mold or grain-quality risk; recent rain makes open-air drying unreliable. ACAP calendar anchor: Jul 16-31 - Rice season 2 - Reproductive / Panicle initiation; Corn season 2 - Vegetative / Leaf development. Recommended action: avoid open sun-drying; use covered temporary storage or mechanical drying where available.

adaptation_measures: Improve drainage and avoid prolonged waterlogging in low-lying fields.
Increase pest and disease scouting for fungal and bacterial disease triggers.
Use resistant varieties and integrated pest management; spray only during safe weather windows.

texts.bulletin: WET SPELL DISEASE WATCH - Cordon: 25 consecutive wet days and high humidity may favor fungal/bacterial diseases. Increase field scouting for rice blast/sheath blight and corn fungal diseases. Spray only when rain and wind conditions are safe.
texts.sms: DA WATCH: Wet/humid days in Cordon. Scout crops for disease; spray only in clear, low-wind weather.

DISEASE WATCH - Cordon
Ask AEWs to intensify field scouting and report pest/disease symptoms by barangay.
texts.facebook: DISEASE WATCH - Cordon: Wet and humid conditions. Inspect rice/corn fields and consult AEW before spraying.

calendar_anchor.note: Advisory is anchored to matching current ACAP rice/corn calendar stage(s).

adaptation_measures: Defer pesticide or foliar spraying during rain, strong wind, or very high humidity.
Resume only during calm, dry windows and follow label safety intervals.
Strengthen pest scouting and non-chemical IPM while spraying is delayed.

texts.bulletin: SPRAYING ADVISORY — Cordon: Do not apply pesticides or foliar fertilizers in rainy conditions. Rain within 4–6 hours of application will wash off chemicals, reducing efficacy and increasing environmental contamination risk. Reschedule spraying to early morning hours on clear days.
texts.sms: DA ADVISORY: Do not spray pesticides when raining. Reschedule to clear morning. Saves money, protects water.

Operation: sun-drying of palay or corn grain
